author: Codex independent critical protocol seat; root owns novelty/cost acceptance

conclusion.capability: 可以用正常post-IOMMU cache响应＋cell-token队列实现同样的permission-pending history→committed DMA ownership；READ计数仍由正常R握手驱动，无需特殊绕过R的raw-adopt。
conclusion.integration: 这要求实际替换现有byte-payload FIFO并增加可信token sideband/allocator。它不是当前iDMA原生接口的免费功能。
conclusion.comparison: 给ordinary同一shared pool/token buffer后，普通物理历史缓存可逐动作实现root规则。是完整架构对照，不把这些共同新增接口冒称现存生产实现或已发表覆盖。

fixed_scope.payload: P6 real64-bit cells; Q_V3/Q_A3; full aligned words only. No separate history payload array. Existing downstream payload spills/staging also计入全机，但两方法可共同保留它们。
fixed_scope.request: One active original READ perflow/perID for minimal implementation; frozen generation; native actual success assured before A cache response; original AR IDs/len/size/attrs preserved.
fixed_scope.mapping: Stable immutable Normal source under legal original READ/order interval; no remap/revocation/MMIO/exclusive/atomic within proof.
fixed_scope.faults: Native physical completion AR or error==0 alone is not access_ok under current DTF/error suppression. Both candidate/control need actual success assurance. General after-commit error recovery is not closed by this card.

minimal_interfaces.pool_token: {cell_id:ceil(log2(P))=3, live_owner/generation guard if stale refs can exist}. All interfaces private/trusted; software cannot forge a pointer into another live cell.
incoming_source: Pool owns allocation reservation before offering the corresponding upstream normal RVALID/token. Cell identity and raw RDATA remain stable through heldVALID.
One actual authorized physical source-R handoff stores payload once. V normalR handshakes enqueue its token and advance its normal READ counters exactly once.

Optional A history retention references the same written cell under A quota. When A quota is full or continuity lost, omit that ref; source READY must depend only on issuer's mandatory capacity/service, never unknown A.
minimal_interfaces.native_to_cache: A follows its actual normal TL/TC path. The cache accepts A's translated physical AR only after actual own-READ success assurance, preserving ID, span, Normal attributes and request-order/snapshot contract. No new prepare origin or canceled accepted downstream AR.
cache_to_dma_R: Carry actual normal AXI RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/ID plus private aligned {pooled_token_valid, cell_id, token_owner_cookie} to the modified DMA buffer.
Token sideband follows every same cut/mux/demux and handshake as the corresponding R. It cannot arrive on a different flow or cycle.
On ordinary RVALID&&RREADY, transport updates original source progress as before. Buffer enqueues a token rather than writing RDATA again.
For a reused history token, that same handshake transfers a reserved pending/replay reference to committed FIFO ownership, without allocating a new cell or charging A quota twice.
Independent new physical miss data allocates a new A cell and enqueues its token under A free mandatory credit.
dma_W: FIFO head exposes token. The shared pool returns the corresponding real word to ordinary WDATA generation; aligned scope avoids byte-lane gather/shift.
Keep head/token and word stable while WVALID&&!WREADY. Drop its committed reference only when data ownership has actually transferred.
If transfer is into an existing downstream payload-holding spill/FIFO, that store becomes the payload owner and is charged. Otherwise retain the pool reference until actual physical W acceptance.
B completion settles original WRITE/descriptor and mapping obligations. It ordinarily need not retain source payload after true data handoff, unless a defined retry protocol still needs it.
minimal_interfaces.completion: Cached prefix plus real suffix returns original N logical words exactly once; suffix physicalRLAST is reconstructed as originalRLAST only at original final offset. All actual WLAST/B and original ACK accounting unchanged.

exact_reference_states.credit: For eachflow history+heldR+committed references consume at most Q_f. Transfer changes class, not cell occupancy or a second quota debit. Refs owned by other flows can share that one cell.
exact_reference_states.allocation: A cell may be reused only when all live reference/response owners are gone. A stale token after ref release is forbidden; if lazy stale tokens are permitted, generation/wrap discipline must be explicitly proved.
exact_reference_states.first_RVALID: Before the cache first offers RVALID, move the selected history ref to a pinned heldR lease or otherwise reserve the accepted-hit snapshot. Native grant/AR acceptance alone does not advance DMA progress.
exact_reference_states.R_handshake: Only R handshake moves heldR to committed FIFO and increments original logical READ counters. READY0 cannot release/reassign cell or overwrite provenance.
exact_reference_states.first_WVALID: The selected committed head still owns the word through first WVALID and all held cycles. Optional history cancellation cannot free a still-committed/held word.
exact_reference_states.W_handshake: Atomically retire FIFO head/ref and transfer data to actual downstream owner. A source credit returned at an upstream spill handshake must not be described as physical memory completion.
exact_reference_states.original_ACK: Only after real logical source completion and every real destination completion required by its original descriptor. R acceptance, token conversion and physicalW acceptance are separate events.

pointer_transfer.minimal_implementation: Use a bounded history token list and ordinary committed token FIFO; both hold metadata only. History-head→heldR→copy-FIFO-tail is atomic with normalR handshake. Separate metadata arrays do not create separate payload arrays.
pointer_transfer.sizes: For P6/Q3 two copy FIFOs need6 tokens=18 cell-ID bits; one A history list adds3 tokens=9bits before cursors/valid/generation. These are identified metadata bits, not total implementation area.
pointer_transfer.no_fake_free_slot: When A already owns history3, reused-token R enqueue may proceed because committed FIFO has space and the ref transfers. An allocator that insists on a fresh Q credit for this enqueue deadlocks at Q3; reuse/ref-transfer must be a genuine token operation.
pointer_transfer.same_array_alternative: If history and committed FIFO use the same physical token slots, ordinary append-at-tail is insufficient when pending entries already fill all3. Need separate commit/read cursors or state bits and in-place class conversion, explicitly priced.
pointer_transfer.wrap_and_cancel: Discarding a history entry removes only that generation's optional ref. Every removal/move must update list/cursors/ref atomically; a FIFO pointer cannot continue to name a freed reused cell.

concrete_complete_ordinary.name: post-IOMMU physical prefix history sharing the same reference-counted pool and token DMA buffers
genuine_ordinary_actions: Physically tagged prefix-cache hit/miss lookup after an accepted normal translated AR.
Reference-counted shared-cell retention for cache/history and multicast/copy consumers.
Zero-copy token enqueue on normalR handshake; ref retirement at real consumer data handoff.
Original-ID response descriptor with hit-prefix/miss-suffix offset and finalRLAST reconstruction.
algorithm: V authorized physicalR stores each word once and its normal READ response transfers a cell token to V copy FIFO.
Keep bounded prefix cell IDs/tag/provenance in A-reserved history credit, without A logicalR or COPY ownership.

A native-translated physicalAR is normally accepted at the cache. On actual success and matching snapshot, keep future prefix hits soft; select and pin only the currently offered response cell, then answer it as normal A R+cell token.
Each A normalR handshake transfers that prefix ref into its token FIFO and advances ordinary transport READ count. No raw pre-permission FIFO push or read-counter adoption bypass.
Issue one real suffix AR for unserved words. Allocate its new source words under A mandatory credit, reconstruct originalID/RLAST and enqueue tokens normally.
Both DMA write paths read shared cells, generate ordinary WDATA and consume committed refs on genuine data handoff; actual W/B/ACKs remain genuine.
Miss/permission failure discards only optional A history and chooses independent read or real error, never cancels V data or a held R/W.
concrete_complete_ordinary.capability_match: Under the fixed stable-success scope, same tag matching, snapshot lease, Q reservation and source schedule, this has exactly root's pending→committed ownership transition and payload-cell invariant.
concrete_complete_ordinary.interface_truth: The token buffer/pool/sideband implementation is new relative to current byteFIFO and must be implemented/charged for this control as well. This card does not prove an exact retrieved paper implements all these interfaces.
concrete_complete_ordinary.meaningful_remaining_difference: A specialized token-only private response could avoid an otherwise required cache-hit RDATA pool read, or reduce metadata/ports, but this must be an explicit private-interface capability with actual costs. Standard normal RDATA cannot silently be undefined to manufacture a free read port.

finite_positive_and_neighbor.positive: N8. V owns3 mandatory tokens at most while first3 cells acquire A optional refs. V can drain and reuse its reserved3 cells. After V completion, A history occupies3/P6; matching normal A physicalAR is accepted. Normal A R handshakes move those same3 IDs to its committed FIFO; W consumes them; independent suffix5 uses newly free A credits. Physical dataR13, realW16, no duplicate prefix payload write or wrong-owner data.
finite_positive_and_neighbor.same_action_control: The specified ordinary cache+shared token pool executes those same events using6 payload cells, not9. Therefore the earlier9-versus6 comparison only beats a separate payload-copy history cache, not this complete unified control.
finite_positive_and_neighbor.held_R_neighbor: A prefix RVALID is held and optional history is canceled. The cell must stay live under heldR lease and presented DATA/token must not change; freeing it at grant, AR acceptance or history eviction is wrong.
finite_positive_and_neighbor.held_W_neighbor: V consumes its history ref, but A WVALID is held. Cell cannot be freed until A's committed ownership transfers to a paid downstream store or physical acceptance.
finite_positive_and_neighbor.quota_neighbor: A pending history must not allocate all6 physical cells solely under a nominal Q3. Perflow distinct owned references include heldR and future committed refs; otherwise V mandatory arrival can be blocked.
finite_positive_and_neighbor.failure_scope: Precommit denied A result safely drops its optional refs. After any normal A R/W has committed, neither data/progress nor offered W may be retracted; a defined real fault/abort/drain protocol is required. Current NO_ERROR is not such a protocol.

changed_modules: Actual idma_buffer payload-byte FIFO replacement with perflow token FIFO and pool read interface.
Transport R sideband integration that preserves existing R-handshake counter updates; aligned W token lookup/output.
Normal response-path TC/mux/demux cuts or equivalent trusted parallel routing for token identity.
Post-IOMMU cache/miss descriptor and original response reassembly; pool allocator/ref/quota controller.
Actual success assurance and real failed-job/error path, common requirements for both controls.
costs_and_limits.ports: One source-payload write. Standard cached-prefix RDATA replay and ordinary WDATA lookup may need simultaneous reads: either explicitly pay at least the required read ports/muxes, or serialize with charged staging/service delays. Normal full RDATA cannot be replaced by a token alone without a new private interface contract.
costs_and_limits.held_payload: R/W/skid/spill payload copies are actual storage. P6 is the pool, not necessarily the whole FPGA payload total. Count any stages even if only one word each.
costs_and_limits.byte_geometry: General unaligned/gather/byte enables need masks, multiple-cell token lists and gather shifters; current byteFIFO semantics cannot be claimed preserved from aligned full-word proof.
costs_and_limits.IDs: Minimal1outstanding original perflow/ID is a restriction. Multiple jobs/bursts require per-ID ordered queue, child identity, response arbitration and generation lifecycle; count them.
costs_and_limits.permission: Post-TL placement does not itself repair error-suppressed native responses. Actual own access_ok and successful request ownership remain a common gate.
costs_and_limits.performance: Payload6 bound does not prove smaller LUT/BRAM or faster cycles once refs/tags/ports/cuts/extra replay reads are counted.

judgement.protocol: Normal cache token queueing can supply the same grant-to-committed transition without a separate special raw-adopt API, provided actual shared token/payload interfaces are built.
judgement.irreversibility: Successful READ grant and local AR acceptance precede exposure; firstRVALID pins response; R handshake commits logical-read/FIFO ownership; heldW cannot retract; W data handoff releases payload, and actual B settles the original WRITE obligation.
judgement.novelty: Use this as the simpler complete architecture control. It removes an automatic independent contribution from the current unified-ownership rule, but is not evidence that a paper already published the exact full implementation.
judgement.next_question: Root compares exact shared-pool/token/miss-record/port costs against the closest real zero-copy/multicast/cache implementation. Only an actual new contract or strict total-cost difference can decide the remaining architecture contribution.
judgement.execution: Three assigned artifacts read, one protocol artifact authored; no source/paper scans, implementation, models, tests, builds or board.

elastic_pending_prefix.kind: Ordinary word-token cache policy plus lazy single-miss response; not a separate replay-recovery mechanism or a published-coverage verdict.
elastic_pending_prefix.AR_acceptance: Fix originalID/totalN/attrs/order and nextOffset k; no hard pin of every future prefix hit follows from acceptedAR.
elastic_pending_prefix.recall: Mandatory demand may remove highest-offset unoffered soft prefix refs only. A physical cell frees only when every hard and soft owner of that cell is removed. Never recall an offered heldR, committed-copy word or heldW.
elastic_pending_prefix.continuity: Highest-offset-first truncates the remaining retained prefix without making holes. Repeated preoffer recalls shorten only unpromised hit supply.
elastic_pending_prefix.offer: Lookup current k and pin its cell before firstRVALID. If recall wins before offer, invalidate/redo that lookup. After firstRVALID the presented DATA/token/ID/LAST and owner stay fixed through READY0.
elastic_pending_prefix.sync_RAM: An uncancelable in-flight internal RAM read needs a temporary lease even before RVALID. Alternative cancelable lookup must kill/retry after a recall and recheck token generation before offer; no invisible stale-cell use.
elastic_pending_prefix.single_miss: At the first actual unserved k after prefix response, issue exactly one suffixAR(start+k,lenN-k). Freeze it at firstVALID. Once miss mode starts, use that physical suffix through originalRLAST; never relookup/reissue already served offsets or issue multiple suffixes after later soft recalls.
elastic_pending_prefix.handshake_cut: Cache compR handshake into an actual TC/Rspill transfers a held-response lease to that paid stage. It is not yet DMA committed ownership. Only final idma normalR handshake enqueues its copy token and updates source counters.
elastic_pending_prefix.W_cut: Committed copy ref persists across heldW until data is retained by an actual charged downstream owner or true physical acceptance. Descriptor/mapping/B debt remains later.
elastic_pending_prefix.cost: Ref classes/selector/cursors, cancelable lookup/generation or RAM-read lease, token routing, actual RDATA read port and held payload stages are counted. No automatic zero-LUT or zero-service-delay claim.
elastic_pending_prefix.immutable_scope: Deferred suffix may sample at a different time. Same immutable-source/legal order or a proper coherence/version contract is necessary.
